title: Technical Content Strategist
description:
Dear Candidates,

Greetings from
**Infinnium !**

We are hiring for the position of
**Technical Content Strategist**
to join our growing US-based IT company in Ahmedabad.

**Designation:**
**Technical Content Strategist**

**Location: Ahmedabad**

**Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site**

**Experience: 1 to 3 Years**

**About Company:**

Infinnium Infotech is redefining the way organizations engage with data to gain actionable intelligence. We develop software solutions for corporations, law firms, and government agencies using modern technologies such as AI and machine learning to support information governance, including compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and other privacy regulations, litigation readiness, and electronic discovery.Our software product brings simplicity to the complex world of digital data, combining the strength of people and modern technology to help organizations effectively address today’s complex information governance needs and realize the intrinsic value of their data.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a Junior Technical Writer / Product Documentation Specialist to join our team and help create and maintain clear, accurate, and user-friendly product documentation.

The role involves working closely with Product, Development, QA, and Support teams to understand product functionality, UI changes, new features, enhancements, and workflows, and convert this information into comprehensive help documentation.

This role will be particularly important as we undergo a major UI transformation of the product, requiring significant documentation updates and new content within defined timelines. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with technical information, reviewing development stories, understanding application workflows, coordinating with technical teams, and using AI powered tools to improve documentation quality and efficiency.

**Role Summary :**

This position is ideal for a technically inclined writer who enjoys learning software products, collaborating with engineering and QA teams, and turning complex product functionality into clear, practical user documentation. Candidates who combine strong English communication skills with technical curiosity, attention to detail, and effective use of AI-assisted tools are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review TFS/Azure DevOps stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical details to understand new features and product changes.
* Analyze existing and newly developed product functionality and understand end-to-end user workflows.
* Work closely with developers, QA/testers, product teams, and support teams to clarify functionality and documentation requirements.
* Participate in discussions, demonstrations, and walkthroughs with developers and testers to understand how features work in the actual product.
* Create and update product help files, user guides, feature documentation, configuration guides, and workflow documentation.
* Document new features and UI changes with clear, structured, and easy-to-understand explanations.
* Review the application UI and ensure documentation accurately reflects the latest screens, fields, buttons, options, workflows, and terminology.
* Identify gaps or inconsistencies between product functionality and existing documentation and coordinate with relevant teams for clarification.
* Document configuration options, prerequisites, permissions, limitations, dependencies, and expected behavior where applicable.
* Update existing documentation whenever product functionality, workflows, or UI elements change.
* Maintain consistency in terminology, formatting, structure, screenshots, and documentation standards across the product.
* Coordinate documentation updates with product releases and ensure documentation is completed within required timelines.
* Upload and publish completed documentation to the product/help system as required.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
* Ability to understand software functionality and explain it in simple, user-friendly language.
* Experience working with software products, SaaS applications, or technical platforms.
* Ability to read and understand user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical discussions.
* Ability to work effectively with developers and QA/testers to understand functionality and validate documentation.
* Good understanding of software development and testing processes.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when documenting UI elements, workflows, configurations, and system behavior.
* Familiarity with TFS/Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar work-management tools.
* Experience with documentation/help-authoring tools or knowledge bases.
* Experience with screenshots, screen annotation, flow diagrams, and other visual documentation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and similar productivity tools.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent tools.

**Yamini Patel**

**USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and UAE**

We are looking for a
**Content Writer**
who can create high-quality, technically credible, and conversion-focused content for Sapiogen AI.

The ideal candidate should be able to simplify complex topics such as
**AI, software engineering, cloud, automation, data, and digital transformation**

* Use AI tools as productivity assistants while ensuring the final content demonstrates human judgment, originality, and expertise.

Website & Conversion Content

* AI Consulting
* AI Product Development
* AI Development
* AI Automation
* Conversational AI
* Voice AI
* Cloud Engineering
* Data Engineering
* Legacy Modernization
* Create industry-specific and use-case landing pages.
* Develop content that communicates Sapiogen AI's differentiation and encourages visitors to take action.
* Write website CTAs, headlines, value propositions, FAQs, and supporting copy.
* Ensure content aligns with Sapiogen AI's brand voice and premium positioning.

Research & Thought Leadership

* Research emerging trends, technologies, market developments, and customer challenges.
* Create thought-leadership articles and opinion-driven content around AI and software engineering.
* Analyze competitor content and identify content gaps and opportunities.
* Interview internal technical experts when necessary to develop technically accurate content.

Content Distribution

* Support email newsletters and campaign content.

  **B2B technology, SaaS, IT services, AI, or software engineering**

* Ability to explain technical concepts in simple business language.
* Understanding of SEO fundamentals and search intent.
* Familiarity with keyword research and content optimization.

**strong researcher and storyteller**

title: SEO Content Writer
description:
**SEO Content Writer**

**Company: Egrowth Partners Pvt Ltd**

**Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India**

**Type: Full-time (Work from Office)**

**Experience: 2 to 4 years**

**Salary: Up to 7 LPA (Based on skills & experience)**

**About us**

EGrowth Partners is the back office and growth team for print businesses in the USA, UK, Canada, Europe and Australia. We run order entry, pre-press, customer service and bookkeeping for printers, and build the websites and marketing that bring in their next job. Everyone on the team is trained in print before working on client accounts, so the role builds real industry expertise.

**About the role**

EGrowth Partners is hiring an SEO Content Writer to create content that ranks on Google, gets cited in AI answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, and brings in leads. You'll work from SEO briefs, research each topic properly, and talk to subject experts when a piece needs real expertise.

Your readers will range from first-time searchers to people who know the subject well, so clear, plain writing matters more here than clever writing.

**What you'll do**

**Writing and publishing**

•     Write blogs, long-form guides, how-tos, comparison posts, service and landing pages, and FAQs from SEO briefs

•     Adjust tone and depth for each audience, and follow the style guide you're given

•     Write titles and meta descriptions that earn the click

•     Format and publish each piece yourself, with clean headings, internal links, images, and alt text

**Content Optimization**

•     Check search intent before you start writing, and shape the piece around what the searcher actually wants

•     Plan and optimize content in Frase, Surfer SEO, or Clearscope

•     Structure content so AI search tools can pull and cite it: direct answers near the top, question-based headings, short definitions, comparison tables, and FAQ sections

•     Build E-E-A-T into each piece with first-hand insight, expert quotes, credible sources, clear author details, and current facts

•     Work with the SEO team on internal linking, schema, and topic clusters

**Quality and expertise**

•     Interview subject matter experts and turn what they know into content a beginner can follow

•     Fact-check every claim and cite your sources

•     Turn technical topics into plain language most readers can follow on the first read, usually around a 6th to 8th grade reading level

•     Proofread and self-edit before anything goes to review

**Performance and updates**

•     Refresh older content that's losing rankings or has gone out of date

•     Check performance in Google Search Console and Google Analytics, and use it to decide what to fix next

•     Track where your content shows up in AI answers and rework what isn't getting picked up

**How we use AI**

You'll use AI tools for research, outlines, and first-pass ideas. The writing, judgment, fact-checking, and final quality are yours. Anything we publish has been written and checked by a person.

**How we measure success**

We look at rankings, organic traffic, AI search visibility, leads from your content, and how few edit rounds a piece needs before it goes live.

**What you'll bring**

•     2 to 4 years of SEO content writing for websites

•     A portfolio of published work, ideally with pieces that rank or have been cited in AI answers

•     Hands-on use of at least one content optimization tool (Frase, Surfer SEO, or Clearscope)

•     A solid grasp of search intent, on-page SEO, and E-E-A-T

•     Working knowledge of how AI search tools choose which sources to cite

•     Experience publishing in WordPress, Webflow, or Shopify

•     Strong written English (C1 or above) and sharp editing skills

•     Comfort working on your own and managing deadlines in a remote or hybrid team

**Nice to have**

•     Experience with other content optimization tools like MarketMuse, NeuronWriter, or Semrush SEO Writing Assistant

•     Experience writing for health, finance, or tech brands

•     Content that's earned backlinks or press mentions

•     Some sense of page layout and UX for content-heavy pages

•     A degree in English, journalism, communications, or marketing (a strong portfolio counts more)

**What we offer**

•     Competitive salary with annual performance reviews

•     Paid earned, casual, and sick leave, plus public holidays

•     Laptop and access to paid SEO and AI tools

**Our hiring process**

1.  A short screening call to talk through your experience and samples

2.  A test piece written to a real brief

3.  A final interview with the hiring manager

**How to apply**

Send your resume, a short cover letter, and 2 to 3 published writing samples to naveen@searchlogy.com

We’d like to see how you optimize, not only how you write. If you used Frase, Surfer SEO, Clearscope, or a similar tool on any sample, share that piece’s link, and your application moves to the front of the review queue.

EGrowth Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and judge every application on skills and work.

description:
Job Description: Content Writer

**Company:**
Sapiogen AI Private Limited

**Department:**
Marketing & Growth

Ahmedabad, Gujarat

About Sapiogen AI

Sapiogen AI is an
**AI-first software engineering company**
helping startups, scale-ups, and enterprises build intelligent software products, modernize technology, automate operations, and accelerate digital transformation.

Our capabilities include
**AI-powered product development, AI consulting, AI development, AI automation & RPA, conversational & voice AI, cloud engineering, data engineering, AI integration, and legacy modernization.**

We are building an international technology brand targeting clients across the
**USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and UAE**
.

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Content Writer**
who can create high-quality, technically credible, and conversion-focused content for Sapiogen AI.

The ideal candidate should be able to simplify complex topics such as
**AI, software engineering, cloud, automation, data, and digital transformation**
and turn them into content that attracts decision-makers, builds authority, supports SEO, and generates business interest.

This is not a generic blog-writing role. You will work closely with the
**SEO and marketing teams**
to create content designed for search engines, AI-powered search platforms, and real business audiences.

Key ResponsibilitiesContent Creation

* Write high-quality blogs, articles, website pages, service pages, landing pages, case studies, and thought-leadership content.
* Create content around AI, software engineering, automation, cloud, data, digital transformation, and emerging technologies.
* Write content that is informative, engaging, authoritative, and aligned with Sapiogen AI's positioning.
* Convert complex technical concepts into clear and easy-to-understand business content.
* Create content for international B2B audiences, particularly decision-makers, founders, CTOs, CIOs, and technology leaders.
* Develop content that communicates business outcomes rather than simply describing technical features.

SEO Content

* Work closely with the SEO Executive/Manager to create keyword-focused content.
* Conduct basic keyword and competitor research to understand search intent.
* Naturally incorporate primary, secondary, and long-tail keywords.
* Create SEO-friendly titles, headings, meta descriptions, FAQs, and content structures.
* Develop content around commercial, informational, and transactional search intent.
* Optimize existing content based on SEO performance and ranking opportunities.
* Support the creation of topic clusters and topical authority around AI and software engineering.

AI Search, AEO & GEO

* Create content optimized for emerging AI-powered search experiences.
* Understand
  **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**
  and
  **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**
  principles.
* Structure content to provide clear, direct, authoritative answers to relevant questions.
* Create FAQ, comparison, definition, use-case, and problem-solution content that can be useful in AI search experiences.
* Maintain strong factual accuracy and avoid producing generic AI-generated content.
* Use AI tools as productivity assistants while ensuring the final content demonstrates human judgment, originality, and expertise.

Website & Conversion Content

* Write and optimize service pages such as:
* AI Consulting
* AI Product Development
* AI Development
* AI Automation
* Conversational AI
* Voice AI
* Cloud Engineering
* Data Engineering
* Legacy Modernization
* Create industry-specific and use-case landing pages.
* Develop content that communicates Sapiogen AI's differentiation and encourages visitors to take action.
* Write website CTAs, headlines, value propositions, FAQs, and supporting copy.
* Ensure content aligns with Sapiogen AI's brand voice and premium positioning.

Research & Thought Leadership

* Research emerging trends, technologies, market developments, and customer challenges.
* Create thought-leadership articles and opinion-driven content around AI and software engineering.
* Analyze competitor content and identify content gaps and opportunities.
* Interview internal technical experts when necessary to develop technically accurate content.
* Support whitepapers, guides, reports, newsletters, and other long-form content initiatives.

Content Distribution

* Create content for LinkedIn and other relevant social platforms.
* Repurpose blogs and long-form content into LinkedIn posts, carousels, short-form content, and other marketing assets.
* Support email newsletters and campaign content.
* Collaborate with the design team to create content briefs for visual assets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 1–3 years of experience in content writing, preferably in
  **B2B technology, SaaS, IT services, AI, or software engineering**
  .
* Excellent written English and strong grammar.
* Strong research and fact-checking abilities.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in simple business language.
* Understanding of SEO fundamentals and search intent.
* Familiarity with keyword research and content optimization.
* Basic understanding of Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar tools is an advantage.
* Understanding of AI, software development, cloud computing, automation, or digital transformation is preferred.
* Ability to write for international audiences, particularly US and UK markets.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to independently research topics and produce original content.

Preferred Skills

* Experience writing for technology companies or IT service companies.
* Knowledge of
  **AEO, GEO, AI search, and content marketing**
  .
* Understanding of B2B lead-generation content.
* Experience creating service pages and landing pages designed for conversions.
* Familiarity with WordPress or modern CMS platforms.
* Experience using AI writing/research tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity.
* Ability to collaborate with SEO specialists, developers, designers, and marketing teams.

What We Expect

We are looking for a writer who can move beyond generic "AI-generated" articles.

Your content should be:

**Research-driven → Technically accurate → Human-written → SEO-friendly → Business-focused → Conversion-oriented.**

You should be able to take a topic such as
**"AI Agent Development for Enterprises"**
and create content that not only ranks in search but also makes a CTO or business leader understand
**why they need it, where it can create value, what implementation involves, and why Sapiogen AI is the right engineering partner.**

Key Performance Indicators

* Quality and consistency of published content.
* Organic visibility and ranking improvement of content.
* Growth in organic traffic and relevant search impressions.
* Engagement and time spent on content.
* Contribution to qualified organic leads and enquiries.
* Number of high-quality content assets delivered on schedule.
* Improvement of existing underperforming content.
* Growth of Sapiogen AI's topical authority across AI and software engineering subjects.

Why Join Sapiogen AI?

* Opportunity to work with an
  **AI-first technology company**
  from an early stage.
* Exposure to AI, software engineering, cloud, automation, and emerging technologies.
* Opportunity to build content for international markets.
* Work closely with SEO, marketing, engineering, and leadership teams.
* Learn and work on emerging areas such as
  **AI Search, AEO, GEO, and AI-assisted content marketing**
  .
* Opportunity for career growth as the marketing organization expands.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a
**strong researcher and storyteller**
who understands technology and can turn complex technical subjects into compelling business content.

If you are passionate about technology, AI, SEO, and storytelling—and want to build content that contributes directly to the growth of an international technology company—we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply now to join Sapiogen AI and help us build the future of AI-first software engineering.**

* Coordinate with regulatory bodies to facilitate the acquisition of necessary environmental permits and clearances.
* Support the process of obtaining Consents to Establish (CTO) and ensure compliance with environmental regulations during project execution.

**Education Qualification**
BE-Chemical/ B.E. Environment / M.Sc. Environment

3– 5 years of relevant experience

Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
  
  
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.
  
  
Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**
As an Integration Analyst, you own, lead and deliver EDI and 3PL integrations between Cin7 customers and external trading partners. You provide technical support to the Cin7 client base, resolving technical issues and determining the client’s service and support needs.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Ownership & Time Management**
Accelerates connection lifecycles toward successful completion through expert troubleshooting and debugging. Proactively manages dependencies for all assigned tasks while participating in requirement analysis and necessary exploratory research. Demonstrates the capability to isolate technical discrepancies to identify fundamental root causes.
  
  
Assumes full accountability for delivering small to medium-complexity projects, adapting functional strategies independently or within a team to secure optimal results.
  
  
**Technical & Product knowledge**
Possesses a comprehensive understanding of EDI architecture and proficiency in the requisite tooling for connection development. Skilled in executing testing protocols to diagnose reproducible defects and propose technical resolutions. Confidently manages compliance validation across diverse retail and trading partner landscapes. Enhances collective team expertise through domain knowledge sharing, supported by a firm grasp of EDI, 3PL, and API integration workflows and bug remediation.
  
  
**Customer Engagement & Escalations**
Maintains proactive, solution-oriented dialogue with clients, ensuring expectations are managed with transparency. Coordinates with leadership to influence outcomes when necessary and provides clear communication regarding functional limitations and feasible paths for issue resolution.
  
  
**Drives Results**
Reliably achieves established monthly and quarterly performance metrics, pursuing ambitious stretch targets to consistently surpass client expectations.
  
  
**Team Work**
Operates with high autonomy, selecting workstreams that align with organizational objectives. Actively participates in collaborative forums to exchange ideas and contributes to the maintenance of critical team documentation.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement**
Evaluates the broader implications of design choices and proposes enhanced alternatives. Cultivates a growth mindset while playing a central role in refining team methodologies and operational practices to increase scalability and efficiency.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Tertiary education with a relevant degree
* 3+ years in a client-facing role, strong understanding of relevant technologies and platforms (supply chain, inventory management, EDI/3PL) and sufficient technical knowledge in SQL, HTML, CSS, and web-based applications.
* Strong technical problem solving skills and complex understanding of customer pain points
* Deep domain knowledge
* Excellent customer service skills with consistent follow-up and the ability to handle customer requests and issues independently. Seeks feedback to improve service delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple connections or projects simultaneously, especially for medium- to large-sized customers.
* Proven track record of delivering exceptional customer service with strong feedback and reviews.
* Change Management skills and the ability to identify and implement process improvements to enhance the efficiency and scalability of EDI/3PL connections.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and conflict resolution skills, with the ability to manage and realign escalated connections.
* Demonstrated ownership skills

**Why work for us?**

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
* Hybrid work environment
* Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

₹12,00,000 - ₹14,00,000 a year
  
  
**Why CIN7?**
CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
  
  
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
  
  
***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***

Greetings from
**Infinnium !**

We are hiring for the position of Technical Writer – Product Documentation to join our growing US-based IT company in Ahmedabad.

**Designation: Technical Writer – Product Documentation**

**Location: Ahmedabad**

**Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site**

**Openings: 2**

**About Company:**

**Infinnium Infotech**
is redefining the way organizations engage with data to gain actionable intelligence. We develop software solutions for corporations, law firms, and government agencies using modern technologies such as AI and machine learning to support information governance, including compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and other privacy regulations, litigation readiness, and electronic discovery.Our software product brings simplicity to the complex world of digital data, combining the strength of people and modern technology to help organizations effectively address today’s complex information governance needs and realize the intrinsic value of their data.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a Technical Writer / Product Documentation Specialist to join our team and help create and maintain clear, accurate, and user-friendly product documentation.The role involves working closely with Product, Development, QA, and Support teams to understand product functionality, UI changes, new features, enhancements, and workflows, and convert this information into comprehensive help documentation.

This role will be particularly important as we undergo a major UI transformation of the product, requiring significant documentation updates and new content within defined timelines. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with technical information, reviewing development stories, understanding application workflows, coordinating with technical teams, and using AI powered tools to improve documentation quality and efficiency.

**Role Summary :**

This position is ideal for a technically inclined writer who enjoys learning software products, collaborating with engineering and QA teams, and turning complex product functionality into clear, practical user documentation. Candidates who combine strong English communication skills with technical curiosity, attention to detail, and effective use of AI-assisted tools are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review TFS/Azure DevOps stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical details to understand new features and product changes.
* Analyze existing and newly developed product functionality and understand end-to-end user workflows.
* Work closely with developers, QA/testers, product teams, and support teams to clarify functionality and documentation requirements.
* Participate in discussions, demonstrations, and walkthroughs with developers and testers to understand how features work in the actual product.
* Create and update product help files, user guides, feature documentation, configuration guides, and workflow documentation.
* Document new features and UI changes with clear, structured, and easy-to-understand explanations.
* Review the application UI and ensure documentation accurately reflects the latest screens, fields, buttons, options, workflows, and terminology.
* Identify gaps or inconsistencies between product functionality and existing documentation and coordinate with relevant teams for clarification.
* Document configuration options, prerequisites, permissions, limitations, dependencies, and expected behavior where applicable.
* Update existing documentation whenever product functionality, workflows, or UI elements change.
* Maintain consistency in terminology, formatting, structure, screenshots, and documentation standards across the product.
* Coordinate documentation updates with product releases and ensure documentation is completed within required timelines.
* Upload and publish completed documentation to the product/help system as required.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
* Ability to understand software functionality and explain it in simple, user-friendly language.
* Experience working with software products, SaaS applications, or technical platforms.
* Ability to read and understand user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical discussions.
* Ability to work effectively with developers and QA/testers to understand functionality and validate documentation.
* Good understanding of software development and testing processes.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when documenting UI elements, workflows, configurations, and system behavior.
* Familiarity with TFS/Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar work-management tools.
* Experience with documentation/help-authoring tools or knowledge bases.
* Experience with screenshots, screen annotation, flow diagrams, and other visual documentation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and similar productivity tools.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent tools.

https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/1hGjZ99xUj

**Thanks & Regards,**

**Yamini Patel**

 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India's first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
 



 Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata Group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission "To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust."
 



  





**Job Description** 




 We are seeking an experienced Process Integration Development (PID) Engineer – MEOL/BEOL Integration for advanced CMOS technologies at 28nm and below, including FinFET nodes. This role is responsible for driving advanced CMOS Process Integration Development, with primary ownership of advanced interconnects (MEOL/BEOL) process integration, enabling technology development, device performance optimization, yield enhancement, and manufacturing readiness.
 



 The successful candidate will drive advanced MEOL/BEOL process integration while working across MEOL/BEOL integration, process\-device interactions, silicon characterization, DOE development, process optimization, technology qualification, technology transfer, and high\-volume manufacturing ramp. The role requires close collaboration with Process Module, Device, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
 



 At Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL), the Technology Development organization is responsible for developing, qualifying, and transferring various technology platforms from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing, enabling world\-class semiconductor technologies and manufacturing excellence.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Own advanced interconnect (MEOL/BEOL) process integration for advanced CMOS technologies (28nm and below), including silicide formation, self\-aligned contacts (SAC), local interconnects, via integration, Cu dual\-damascene processing, low\-k dielectric integration, barrier/liner engineering, RC optimization, and interconnect reliability to achieve target device performance, manufacturability, and reliability.
* Develop and optimize CMOS Process Integration technologies for 28nm and below technology nodes by driving process\-device interactions, DOE\-driven silicon learning, process characterization, and process window optimization.
* Analyze process integration trade\-offs using strong semiconductor device physics to optimize transistor characteristics, including Vt, Id, Ioff, DIBL, SS, mobility, matching, variability, and reliability, while achieving target device performance and manufacturability.
* Support technology qualification, technology transfer, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp activities, enabling successful transition from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing.
* Drive manufacturing excellence through defect reduction, process capability enhancement, process robustness, and yield ramp activities using SPC, Cp/Cpk analysis, defect Pareto analysis, excursion investigations, and root\-cause analysis to improve process stability, device performance, and yield.
* Establish process\-to\-device and yield correlations through analysis of inline metrology, WAT/PCM, electrical characterization, defectivity, physical analysis, reliability, and yield data to identify integration risks, process sensitivities, and process optimization opportunities.
* Utilize DOE, TCAD, JMP, Python, statistical analysis, and advanced data analytics (AI/ML methodologies) to accelerate technology learning, process optimization, and yield enhancement. Experience with one or more of these tools is a plus.
* Collaborate with Device, Process Module, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to drive device characterization, reliability qualification, yield improvement, technology transfer, and production ramp.
* Provide technical expertise to solve complex process integration challenges while driving innovation, continuous improvement, and manufacturing excellence.



**Essential Attributes** 



* Strong expertise in advanced CMOS Process Integration for 28nm and below technology nodes, with solid understanding of MEOL and BEOL integration, process\-device interactions, and semiconductor manufacturing.
* Demonstrated expertise in advanced interconnect (MEOL/BEOL) process integration, including silicide formation, self\-aligned contacts (SAC), local interconnect integration, via integration, Cu dual\-damascene processing, low\-k dielectric integration, barrier/liner engineering, RC optimization, and interconnect reliability.
* Hands\-on experience in 28nm planar CMOS or more advanced logic technology nodes. Experience with FinFET technology, advanced interconnect integration, advanced patterning, and next\-generation device architectures is a plus.
* Strong semiconductor device physics foundation with the ability to optimize transistor performance parameters such as Vt, Id, Ioff, DIBL, SS, mobility, variability, matching, reliability, and manufacturability through process integration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with proven experience in DOE development, process characterization, statistical analysis, process window optimization, silicon learning, and root\-cause analysis of process, device, yield, and reliability issues.
* Proven experience in technology qualification, technology transfer, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp, enabling successful transition from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing.
* Demonstrated track record in yield improvement, defect reduction, SPC, Cp/Cpk enhancement, excursion management, process robustness, and high\-volume manufacturing support for advanced semiconductor technologies.
* Ability to correlate inline metrology, WAT/PCM, electrical characterization, defectivity, physical analysis, reliability, and yield data to identify integration risks, process sensitivities, and process optimization opportunities.
* Experience with TCAD, JMP, Python, statistical tools, and advanced data analytics (AI/ML methodologies) is a plus.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills with Device, Process Module, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
* Strong communication, technical presentation, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to drive innovation, continuous improvement, and technical decision\-making in a fast\-paced semiconductor technology development environment.



**Qualifications** 



* M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or related field with 3\+ to 10 years of experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or related field with 7\+ to 15 years of experience.
* Experience in 28nm planar CMOS, FinFET, or advanced logic technologies.
* Strong understanding of semiconductor device physics, process integration, DOE, statistical analysis, yield analysis, and process optimization.
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

**Valuation \& Transaction Advisory Intern / Article Assistant
 



  





 We are looking for a driven, detail\-oriented candidate to join our core advisory team.
 



  





 If you are passionate about corporate finance and transaction advisory, this role offers hands\-on deal exposure from day one.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




* Business Valuation \& Modeling: Assist in DCF models, market multiples (CCA/CTA), and financial projections for M\&A, fund\-raising, and regulatory compliance.



  




* AIF \& Fund Advisory: Support in fund structuring, regulatory documentation, and portfolio reporting for Alternative Investment Funds.



  




* Regulatory Compliance: Work on valuation and compliance matters under FEMA, Companies Act, and Income Tax rules.



  




* Transaction Support: Assist in financial and tax due diligence, deal documentation, and boutique advisory engagements.



  





 Who Should Apply
 



  




* CA / CS / CMA students eligible for articleship/internship, or finance graduates pursuing CFA.



  




* Strong foundational knowledge of accounting, corporate finance concepts, and MS Excel.



  




* Location: On\-site only in Ahmedabad (Remote/hybrid not available).



  




* Commitment: Only candidates with a long\-term horizon for internship/articleship training should apply. Short\-term/summer applicants will not be considered.**
